title: ABC-cluster manuscript assets
description: Deployment templates and a reviewer protocol for ABC-cluster, a command-line platform delivering batch pipeline execution, interactive analysis and data-app hosting on commodity, heterogeneous and intermittently connected hardware. Companion artefact to the ABC-cluster manuscript.
